methodology: Independent curated Russian user-style questions grounded in published reachable child-safe cards. Not production user logs. Oracles frozen before candidate/baseline scoring. Source status retained; published editorial cards disclose incomplete verification rather than claiming all legal facts verified. Retrieval and ideal-selection assembly are offline diagnostics, never evidence of model correctness.
